rows.statement: At the No-Tell Motel at the end of the Konpeki Plaza job, Dex DeShawn shot V.
rows.notes: Not a branch but an unconditional beat of The Heist. Scene q005_15_no_tell_motel (ah5-02 batch) is a single conversation with Dex at the motel whose last beat is Dex's betrayal: Dex says V's name-style lines then V reacts 'Dex, what the fuck?!' / choice 'The fuck are you doing?!' | 'I'll fucking kill you!' (nodes 872, 873, 880, 958); every dialogue path ends in the shooting, only wording differs (q005_lie_relic, q005_dex_loop_end). Phase q005_09_no_tell_motel runs scene (node 37) -> journal q005_heist succeeded (45) -> q005_active=0 (82) -> q005_done=1 exact (65), so q005_done is written only after the motel scene completes. q005_done is also written by history-init/standalone phases (mq055, ep1 start, mq048, tests), so the rule is guarded by jt.heist.briefing (journal participate_briefing, only exists in a real play-through). Saves: q005_done=1 in all 8 playthroughs; journal q005_heist/return/talk_dex succeeded in the 6 full-play playthroughs and absent in the two history-init ones (653599, 65df79) where q005_done is 1 but the briefing journal is not set. Statement says only that Dex shot V, nothing about the aftermath.

rows.statement: In the Arasaka lobby V told Frank Nostra they were in a rush, and the reunion chat was cut short.
rows.notes: Scene q000_corpo_02_to_elevators (ah5-04). The only writer of q000_corpo_02_cut_short (node 433, graph[35], =1 exact) is reached only from the player options 'I'm in a rush.' (choice 12 option 1) and 'I need to run.' (choice 61 option 3), after which Frank says 'Listen, sorry, uh, in a bit of a rush right now? We'll talk another time' (node 59). history-init phases do not write it (they write choice_02_done only). Caveat: q000_corpo_02_choice_02_done (used by the mapped frank-chat rule) is set by the And node 1636 after ANY of the three topic questions (Cape Town, Jenkins, boss), so a V who asked one topic and then said 'I need to run' has both facts; the mapped 'completed' rule can therefore co-fire with this one. 03a_talk_friend succeeds on both paths (prior review), kept only as a stage guard.
rows.unverifiedBecause: q000_corpo_02_cut_short is never nonzero in any of the 110 saves (not-in-dict; no real playthrough took the cut-short option) and is not in the pack allowlist, so no real-save confirmation of the write.

rows.statement: In the War Pigs confrontation V talked Frank Nostra down and he stood down, ending the standoff without a fight.
rows.notes: Scene mq041_corpo_02_confrontation (ah5-02). V's persuasion line 'It's a closed book, Frank. Gotta refigure your life. Game over, start again.' (node 204; reached from 'Open your eyes' node 191 or 'Gotta start over' choice 55 option 1) fans out to: EquipItem (768), SetAttitudeGroup friendly for Frank (687), MovePuppet + two workspots (247, 359, 1226) and SetVar mq041_var_frank_sofa=1 exact (438) then the quest-entry updates, Johnny's closing lines and End. Combat branches (V's 'I kill you right here and now', 'Go ahead, try') never pass node 204 and write no fact. So frank_sofa>=1 is a positive, exclusive 'talked down, attitude friendly' marker. It does NOT distinguish suicide from walking away: the catalog outcomes are walked-away / self-inflicted-death, and the scripted workspot content (sofa) could not be read from the graph, so the outcome key walked-away is the closest fit, not an exact one. No fact exists for killed / incapacitated / suicide (all use killed|defeated|unconscious community conditions).
rows.unverifiedBecause: mq041_var_frank_sofa is never nonzero in any save (4 playthroughs finished mq041: 683244, 65a9d8, 5fd173, 65df79; none took the talk-down) and is not allowlisted; the sofa workspot content was not readable, so it is unproven that the end state is 'walked away alive' rather than another calm end.

rows.statement: In the briefing with Dex and Jackie, V told Dex that something felt off about Evelyn Parker.
rows.notes: Scene q005_01_plan (priority-jackie-takemura batch). q005_01_evelyn_fluff=1 exact (node 3428, graph[96]) is written ONLY by option 2 'Something's off about her.' of choice 3385, itself reachable only after option 0 'Pretty well. Saw Konpeki Plaza from the inside.' of choice 3545 (sceneview confirms both are exclusive). The disclosure fact q005_01_dex_knows (node 3387) is written only via 3545 option 1 or 3385 option 1, so evelyn_fluff and dex_knows cannot both be set in one pass (3385 is a one-shot choice). This is only the 'withheld but hinted' half of 'withheld': V who answers 'That's it. Let's go over the plan.' withholds with no fact at all, so absence stays a non-signal. Statement is limited to what V said.
rows.unverifiedBecause: q005_01_evelyn_fluff is not in the allowlist and never nonzero in any save (the scene-local q005_01_* facts do not appear in the 110 saves, even q005_01_v_sits, so they may not persist), so there is no real-save confirmation; it also covers only one of the two withholding paths.

rows.statement: At the Dashi parade V spared the defeated Oda instead of killing him.
rows.notes: Scene q112_08_parade_speech (priority-jackie-takemura batch). q112_08_oda_spared=1 (node 372, graph[42]) is written only through the single-option choice 43 'It's your lucky day today...' which is offered while Oda is down but not killed (condition 366 killed>=1 false; Takemura on the holocall: 'Do not kill him'). The kill path writes q112_oda_dead (node 341, already used by jt.oda-fate.killed) and V's 'I'm sorry, Oda.' instead. Same speaker/guard convention as the mapped jt.oda-fate.killed (takemura, participant, guarded by jt.parade.oda-defeated). Hanako is not on that call and is left out.
rows.unverifiedBecause: q112_08_oda_spared is never nonzero in any save and not allowlisted: in 5 of 6 playthroughs that passed the Oda fight V did not kill him (q112_oda_dead absent) yet the fact is unset, so the mercy prompt can be skipped; a real spare was never observed.

rows.statement: Royce went down under the Militech assault on All Foods while V and Jackie were there.
rows.notes: Scene q003_04d_shootout_militech (ah5-01). Node 301 writes q003_royce_dead=1 after node 298: CharacterKilled(#royce, killed OR defeated OR unconscious, entireCommunity=1). The other writers of q003_royce_dead are q003_03_deal node 8612 (only the 'Shoot Royce' option, i.e. q003_deal_royce_shoot, which cannot coexist with the Militech assault) and the royce_bossfight phase (hostile no_deal route, where Militech does not invade), so militech_invades>=1 AND royce_dead>=1 isolates the Militech-assault writer. The scene scripts the reaction (DumDum: 'They killed Royce!!!', Jackie: 'They got him! He's done!'). Real saves 65224c and 5fd173 (the only militech_invades=1 playthroughs) both have royce_dead=1. Totentanz routing (sq011_nancy node 276) was checked and cannot serve as an alive marker (Royce is shown there unless dead AND dumdum dead AND combat AND no_deal).
rows.unverifiedBecause: The flag is set for killed, defeated or unconscious, so 'killed' is not proven (prior review's concern stands); the statement was worded as 'went down' for that reason. Both Militech saves agree but no save shows Royce alive after a Militech assault.

rows.statement: Brick was killed when the mine he was rigged to went off in the All Foods factory while V and Jackie were there.
rows.notes: DRAFT ONLY, THIS CONDITION IS NOT EXCLUSIVE: q003_brick_dead=1 is written by q003_05_transition node 1080 after the charge detonates, but q003_end node 325 also writes q003_brick_dead=1 whenever q003_brick_saved>0, so the fact is also 1 after a rescue (saves 683244, 64a0c3, 653802 have both facts =1). The real discriminator found in the 9 playthroughs is a journal objective: quests/main_quest/prologue/q003_maelstrom/03_escape/15_talk_to_brick5 is failed only in save 65224c (brick_dead=1, brick_saved absent) and succeeded in the three rescue saves, which also have 15_talk_to_brick2 succeeded (absent in 65224c). Needs the 15_talk_to_brick5 journal entry in the pack and more than one dead-Brick save before it can be a rule.
rows.unverifiedBecause: The draft condition fires after rescues too; the exclusive signal is a journal entry not in the pack's allowlist (see newJournal), seen in only one save (65224c).

newJournal.role: failed only in the playthrough where Brick died in the trap (65224c); succeeded in the three rescue playthroughs
succeeded only after a rescue (683244, 64a0c3, 653802); absent in 65224c. Could back the existing rescued rule

rows.statement: During the Big Pete job, V's confrontation with Pete ended in a fight and Pete was left dead or knocked out; Dakota's debrief was the one for that result.
rows.notes: Writer: sts_bls_ina_02_ow questphase node 14 sets ina_02_big_pete_dead=1 (hash-bound copy in sts_bls_inland_avenue). Its trigger (node 19) is questCharacterKilled on #ina_02_com_big_pete with killed=1, defeated=1, unconscious=1, so the fact means killed OR knocked out, not death alone; the statement says so. In sts_bls_ina_02_big_pete_scene Pete is alive and standing at the standoff; the three spare options (Deal / Fine but I don't want your money / Eddies now) set ina_02_big_pete_spared=1 and he walks away, while 'No can do' sets ina_02_bp_attack and starts the fight. So the dead fact belongs to the fight branch. Real saves: 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173 have dead=1 and spared never appears in any save. Dakota's debrief phone message (contacts/dakota_smith/sts_bls_ina_02/...) is selected by dead>0 in ow node 109. Remaining doubt: a V who shot Pete before talking could in theory also reach the scene; not seen in the graph. Not usable for paid/unpaid spare.

rows.statement: After the Aldecaldo initiation party, Panam sent V her friendly check-in messages about the chip and her plans, the friends version of her ending hook rather than the romantic one.
rows.notes: q114_msg_panam_ending_hook questphase node 1 branches on sq027_panam_lover>0: True side sends contacts/panam/q114_panam_ending_hook_lover/*, False side sends q114_panam_ending_hook_friendship/*, including 02_msg_panam_friend (pack key al5.panam.friendship-hook, already used as guard of al5.devil.called-platonic). sq027_panam_lover is written only in sq027_06_panzer (and test scenes) and is 1 in saves 683244, 64a0c3, 65224c; the friendship message is active in 65a9d8, 653802, 5fd173. The two sets of saves are disjoint. Caveat: the hook is sent for anyone who reaches q114 without the lover fact, including a V who skipped the Panam job, so the statement avoids claiming the Queen of the Highway job was completed.
rows.unverifiedBecause: The decision aldecaldos.queen.romance already has rules under the reviewed topic alias aldecaldos.panam-basilisk-intimacy; a rule with the canonical topic is refused (narrative_topic_identity.mjs). Joining needs a reviewed alias entry and a native-reviews note, which this change does not add. The signal itself (the Panam friendship hook message is active) is sound and the save sets are disjoint.

rows.statement: At the Aldecaldo camp party Benedict, whom V had extracted in the MIA job, was present among the guests.
rows.notes: q114_party questphase: node 152 reads ina_09_finished>0; True feeds a pause on #ina_09_com_ben being spawned and then the q114_04b_party scene input Benedict_In; False skips it. ina_09_finished is written in sts_bls_ina_09_openworld node 34 (MIA complete) and is 1 in saves 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173. The journal guard is the party objective talk_panam (pack key al5.initiation.party-talk-panam), which keeps the row from firing before the party stage; no save reaches the party objective, so that half of the guard is never observed. Statement keeps 'present' only and does not say anything Ben said or whether he was alone (ina_09_ben_left_alone exists in 5fd173).

rows.statement: After the Basilisk was recovered, V turned down Panam's push to pursue Nash further, and Rogue later sent V the message about the clean deal.
rows.notes: q103_14_maelstrom scene (scene-evidence/priority-panam-20261004-ghost-handoff) sends Rogue's contacts/rogue/q103/q103_clean_deal text only on the branch where q103_helped_panam is 0; q103_helped_panam is written by q103_11_tunnel_drive node 16 on the help choice. Positive signal exists but is a phone message not yet in the pack journal allowlist, and it is '-' in all 9 playthroughs (every real save helped Panam). The prior review also notes the decision's topic-alias domain blocks an exact catalog topic.
rows.unverifiedBecause: The journal path is not in the pack allowlist, was never observed in any save, and the topic alias row cannot be edited in this lane.

newJournal.role: Rogue's message sent only when V did not help Panam against Nash

rows.statement: V brought Iris Tanner to Dakota but Iris's van was not delivered with her, and Dakota's job closed with that result.
rows.notes: sts_bls_ina_06_ow: node 276 sets opt_get_iris_car and park_car_in_garage to Failed on the False side of ina_06_car_delivered after ina_06_dakota_met>0. ina_06_car_delivered=1 is written only after the car arrives. The draft needs the failed state of the objective opt_get_iris_car (a new journal path) together with dakota_met; as written the two facts alone also match the delivered-with-van branch, so this draft cannot execute. ina_06_iris_hired and finished are also written on the ina_06_tanner_left_alone path (Iris abandoned), where Dakota's debrief says she was left high and dry, so that overlap would have to be separated too.
rows.unverifiedBecause: No positive marker that separates 'no van' from 'van delivered' or from 'Iris left alone'; the objective failure is not in the allowlist and was never observed in saves.

newJournal.role: Failed state after V meets Dakota without the car delivered

rows.statement: After their dinner together in Following the River, V kissed River and the two became intimate.
rows.notes: Scene sq029_04a_dinner (scene-evidence rel-sq029-20261005). questSetVar sq029_river_had_sex=1 exact (node 1753, graph[154]) is the only writer (W1 across the quest index and all exported scenes). sceneview: the kiss choice (node 404) option 0 '[Kiss]' is the ONLY option leading to the write; option 1 'I can't, River. I'm sorry.' (caption nokiss) does not. The earlier chain also needs the 'Just don't fall in love...' (427) and 'I can see what you're doin'' (422) options, the other options there lead to just_friends. Saves: sq029_river_had_sex=1 in playthrough 5fd173 (3 of 3 saves). Overlap to flag for the reviewer: the existing jr-native.river-relationship-committed rule (sq029_river_lover from sq029_05_morning_after) is also true whenever this one is, because the morning scene is only reached after the kiss/sex branch, so the two outcomes of the same topic are both true after a committed morning; there is no positive marker for 'intimate but not committed'. The statement says only that intimacy occurred and does not mention commitment.

rows.statement: While cooking and eating together in Following the River, V asked River about his parents and River told V what had happened to them.
rows.notes: Scene sq029_02a_arrival (scene-evidence rel-sq029-20261005). questSetVar sq029_02_dark_story=1 exact (node 1140, graph[94]) is the only writer (W1). sceneview: choice node 1125 option 1 'Your parents - what happened?' (caption dark) is the ONLY option that reaches the write; option 0 'Hmm. Maybe not just now.' does not, so the fact is set only if V asked. Saves: 1 in playthrough 683244 (69 of 93 saves, set from the start of that scene onward). Caveat: choice node 926 'You don't have to go on...' sits upstream of the write, so V can still interrupt after the story has begun and the fact is already set; the statement therefore says River told V what happened and does not claim the full account was heard (the 'stopped' outcome cannot be separated and is a no-signal disposition).

rows.statement: For the MaxTac convoy job in Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, V chose Sandra Dorsett as the netrunner to get convoy intelligence from.
rows.notes: Phase q305_01_task, Sandra sub-phase (path nodes/6/Data/phaseGraph/nodes/20): q305_01_netrunner_picked_Sandra=1 exact (nodes 20/20 and 20/24) and q305_got_netrunner=1 exact (node 20/26) are written only inside the Sandra branch, mirroring the Nix, Mr Hands and Chang branches; the netrunner choice is exclusive. Both facts are already [ALLOW] and used by phantom.priority.steel-intel-sandra (with the pph.steel-intel-sandra journal for Reed). q305_got_netrunner=1 in playthroughs 683244 (Nix branch) and 65224c (Mr Hands branch); q305_01_netrunner_picked_Sandra itself is never nonzero in the 110 saves (no real playthrough chose Sandra), so this rests on the pack's own use of the facts. Overlap to flag: the existing jr5.steel.sandra-contact.intel-delivered rule (journal jr5.steel.sandra-send-reed) is a later stage of the same topic and is also true whenever Sandra was chosen and delivered; there is no predicate for 'chosen but intel not yet delivered', so both outcomes will be true after delivery. Statement says only that V chose Sandra.

rows.statement: When V met Sandra Dorsett about the MaxTac convoy, Sandra asked V to deploy a Trojan virus of hers during the job.
rows.notes: Scene q305_02e_sandra, questSetVar q305_sandra_task_accepted=1 exact (node 108, graph[25]; only writer W1; already [ALLOW] and used by phantom.priority.steel-sandra-task-accepted for Reed and Songbird as told-by-v). sceneview: choice 43 offers 'Sure, do it if I get the chance.', 'What if I refuse?', 'What's this virus do?' and 'Who you spyin' on MaxTac for?', and ALL of them reach node 108, as does option 0 of choice 23 and option 0 of choice 35; the 'Refuse' captioned option of choice 23 also appears to rejoin. So the fact means 'Sandra made her request' and not that V agreed; the statement therefore claims only that she asked. Overlap to flag: the existing jr5.steel.sandra-favor.fulfilled-confirmed (journal jr5.steel.sandra-thanks) is the terminal stage of the same exclusive topic; both outcomes are true after fulfilment (the prior reviewer's reason). Never nonzero in any of the 110 saves.
rows.unverifiedBecause: q305_sandra_task_accepted is absent in all 110 saves, I could not prove that every path out of the Sandra scene writes it only after the request has actually been spoken (the refusal branch of choice 23 was not traced to the end), and the outcome overlaps the mapped fulfilled-confirmed outcome.

rows.statement: In The Hunt, with the search narrowed to two farms, V voted to check Edgewood Farm first.
rows.notes: Scene sq021_07_ride_back. Choice 502 option 0 '[Stand] Let's try Edgewood Farm.' (caption Farm1) is the ONLY option leading to sq021_good_farm_chosen=1 (node 615, graph[87]) in this scene; option 1 '[Stand] I vote Poppy Farm.' writes sq021_bad_farm_chosen (graph[12], pack jr5.hunt.location.poppy). sq021_good_farm_chosen is also written by other nodes: sq021_finale (twice) and sq029 (standalone/debug starts, two nodes), so it is only a valid signal together with the scene-local sq021_v_has_2_choose (non-exact, graph[137] in the same scene, only writer, reached on the two-farm vote). Saves: sq021_good_farm_chosen=1 in 683244, 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173 (all had sq021_v_knows_farm=1, i.e. the deduced route) and sq021_v_has_2_choose is absent in all of them, so the two-farm vote may be a rare path or the fact may not persist. The existing jr5.hunt.location.edgewood-deduced rule requires v_knows_farm; this row cannot exclude v_knows_farm without a zero test, so if V both deduced and was shown the vote the two outcomes would overlap. The statement avoids saying V lacked clues.
rows.unverifiedBecause: sq021_v_has_2_choose is never nonzero in any save, so there is no real-save confirmation, and it is not proven that the fact is written only when V lacks the farm deduction (exclusivity with edgewood-deduced is unproven).

rows.statement: When Claire Russell first called V about joining her racing team in The Beast in Me, V turned the offer down.
rows.notes: Scene sq024_00_claire_hook: questSetVar sq024_v_said_not_interested_at_start=1 (node 111, graph[8]) is reached ONLY from choice 67 option 1 'Racing? Don't think so. No thanks.'; option 0 'OK, sounds good.' does not write it. The same fact has two further writers in the questphase sq024_00_hook (nested phase node 14, two entries) that I could not read, so it may also be set on another branch of the hook (for example a later missed call). Narrower than the outcome text 'V declined; the job failed': the statement covers only the first-call refusal. sq024_quest_declined (written on the meta-quest Failed path, sq024 questphase node 13/2) is NOT used because the prior review showed it also covers prevention failures. Never nonzero in any of the 110 saves.
rows.unverifiedBecause: Never set in a real save and two of the three writers (in sq024_00_hook, nested node 14) were not read, so exclusivity to the 'No thanks' option is not proven; the outcome also describes a failed job, which this fact does not establish.

rows.statement: Takemura, whom V had rescued from the safe house, accompanied V through the assault on Arasaka Tower, and V went on to confront Yorinobu on the CEO floor.
rows.notes: q113_11_top_atrium switches on q112_takemura_dead (nodes 82/93/191) and the atrium scene has a separate takemura_dead entry, so the tower assault has exactly an alive-Takemura and a dead-Takemura variant. q112_takemura_dead is set by q112_10_safe_house nodes 71/207 and reset only on the 06i_save rescue path, so hideout-rescue succeeded means the alive variant. The set-var q113_atrium_takemura_talked is NOT used: it is also reachable from the dead variant (node 191 True -> 174 -> 173 -> 164). Real save 683244 EndGameSave-2 has hideout S, 02_survive S, 05_confront_yorinobu S and q112_takemura_dead 0. Uncertain: Takemura could in principle be lost between the atrium and the CEO floor; no such writer found.

rows.statement: V fought through the assault on Arasaka Tower and confronted Yorinobu on the CEO floor without Takemura, who had been lost at the safe house.
rows.notes: q112_takemura_dead is [ALLOW] and already drives jt.takemura-fate.left-behind and ah5.estate.takemura-absent (set at q112_10_safe_house nodes 71/207, reset only on the rescue path). The atrium phase has a takemura_dead scene entry, so the tower assault continues without him. Hanako is named as witness because ah5.tower.hanako-takes-over (06_ceo_floor/05b_hanako) puts her on the CEO floor at the end of the assault.
rows.unverifiedBecause: q112_takemura_dead is 0 in every real save (no save of the Takemura-lost story), so the combination was never observed; Hanako's presence in the dead-Takemura variant was not read in the scene.

rows.statement: Rogue had been killed during the assault on Arasaka Tower, so she was not at the Afterlife when V stopped there for a drink with Claire during the epilogue.
rows.notes: q116_rogue_dead is [ALLOW] (silverhand.rogue-killed) and is 1 in real save 683244 EndGameSave-3. q203_05_afterlife and the q203_afterlife phase were read: Rogue's seat/scene part is gated on her being alive; the drink objective afterlife/drink is the Afterlife stop the pack already reads (jr5.sun.claire-sendoff.met). Claire tends the bar and is a roster key.
rows.unverifiedBecause: jr5.sun.claire-drink is succeeded in none of the 110 saves and q116_rogue_dead is nonzero only in an ending save, so the combination was never observed in a real save.

rows.statement: Kerry and V had the private intimate encounter aboard the yacht during Boat Drinks.
rows.notes: Only visible writer is sq028_05_sex (graph node 6, value 1, plus a test quest). The writer is an And node that needs all inputs and its only wired entry is Start_demolition, i.e. the sex path itself, not scene start (this corrects the earlier note that it fires before the Kiss/Stop choice). sq028_02_cruiser and sq028_07_trashy_beach both read the fact with GreaterOrEqual 1. Complement is already mapped via talk_kerry2 succeeded.
rows.unverifiedBecause: sq028_kerry_sex is not set in any of the 110 real saves, so no save ever confirmed the fact on the encounter path; the unexported part of the scene could hold another writer.

rows.statement: In the Lucretia hideout V took the NUSA oath that Myers administered and pledged to the cause.
rows.notes: Writer: q302_04_squot scene (scene-evidence/priority-phantom-20261004-extra) graph[301] sets q302_oath_pledged=1 only on the oath pledge lines; the four pledge options each lead only to that writer, and there is no other writer in the quest-graph index or the scene exports. Real saves: 683244:1 and 64a0c3:1 (quest completed in both). Reed's own q306_10_finale scene (scene-evidence/phantom-authenticated-oct01) node 3966 reads q302_oath_pledged==1 and then has Reed answer 'Just as you swore', so the game itself lets Reed refer to it. Myers (the administering witness) is not a roster key; Reed is the one who shows he knows. Not proven: whether Songbird knows (not listed as a speaker on purpose).

rows.statement: At Lina Malina's mansion V used the [Hack schedule] option and booked her into a fake shoot with Tool to lure her out.
rows.notes: Writer: mq303_02_linas_mansion scene (scene-evidence/pg5-04) graph[100] sets mq303_linas_pc_hacked=1; sceneview says only choice 751 option 0 '[Hack schedule]' leads to it (preceded by the line 'Scheduled her for a shoot with Tool'). Only reader is the scene's own later choice option (graph[20] option 1), so the game also treats it as a branch marker. The earlier line 'No dice. Her systems are ICEd to the gills. Plan B' sits 9 hops upstream and belongs to a different path.
rows.unverifiedBecause: mq303_linas_pc_hacked is zero or absent in all 110 real saves (every save took the paid or other route), so it was never observed set. Also unproven that Lina herself learns V tampered with her schedule (she is meant to 'buy it'); Hands is not shown being told either, so the speaker is the weakest part of this row.

rows.statement: In Heaviest of Hearts V accepted Georgina's offer to anonymize Michael Maldonado's testimony instead of having it deleted.
rows.notes: Writer: sts_ep1_06_george scene (scene-evidence/pg5-04) graph[17] sets sts_ep1_06_testimony_agree=1, reached only through the line 'Fine, deal. Don't trust you, but that goes double for Mike.' which follows choice 1123 option 0 'Fine. We have a deal.' after Georgina says 'I'm offering to anonymize Michael's testimony'. The delete option ('I don't believe you. Delete the testimony.') writes sts_ep1_06_deal_refuse and testimony_withdrawn=1 instead, so the two branches are exclusive. The deal path then sets testimony_withdrawn=0 exact. Reads: the client scene shows option 1 'Georgina scrubbed your name from the testimony' only while withdrawn==0, and Hands' holocall debrief (sts_ep1_06_holocall_debrief graph[17], withdrawn==0 branch) opens 'I just got off the holo with Mr. Maldonado. He was most certainly not pleased', while the withdrawn==1 branch is the 'most satisfied' variant already used by pg5.hearts.deleted, so Hands does hear about this outcome.
rows.unverifiedBecause: sts_ep1_06_testimony_agree is 'not-in-dict': never present in any of the 110 saves (the saves took the delete branch or withdrawn stayed 0 without the deal), so it was never observed set. Hands' debrief reads withdrawn==0 only as an absence, not testimony_agree, and which socket of that debrief condition is the true branch was inferred from the dialogue, not tested in game.

rows.statement: In the Shot by Both Sides lab standoff V sided with Dante and Bree Whitney was shot dead.
rows.notes: Writer: mq305_04_bunker scene (scene-evidence/pg5-04) graph[241] sets mq305_v_killed_bree=1 (then mq305_bree_dead=1 at graph[249]). The only writer. The game reads it in mq305_outcome node 66: true sends Hands the phone message contacts/mr_hands/mq305/v_kills_bree and the V reply group 03b_ch_v_kills_bree; false sends mq305_03c_v_leaves_bree_alone. Those message paths are not in the pack, so they would be the best signal. Once Bree is dead the kill_dante objective is made inactive, so Dante normally survives.
rows.unverifiedBecause: mq305_v_killed_bree is in no save (all 5 playthroughs that finished the quest sided with Bree: kill_dante succeeded, mq305_dante_killed=1). Which player choice triggers the writer is not cleanly proven: the standoff choice 575 'Sure do.' also writes mq305_V_told_Bree_hide in the same neighbourhood. Dante staying alive is not provable, since mq305_both_killed (V kills Bree and later Dante) shares the same prerequisite and cannot be excluded by a condition. The statement therefore claims only that V sided with Dante and Bree died.

newJournal.role: Hands phone message written only when mq305_v_killed_bree is set; the cleanest Hands-side signal
V's reply to that message; same condition

rows.statement: Joshua was killed during the Sinnerman job, completing the hit Wakako had arranged; the job then pointed V to call Wakako about the payment.
rows.notes: Writer: sq023_hook questphase, sub-phase at Data/RootChunk/graph/Data/nodes/25, node 15 sets sq023_joshua_killed=1 exact right after activating the objective hook/call_wakako_money (the call to Wakako for the money). That sub-phase is entered from the parent graph through the combat_cleanup_out exit of the sq023_11_01a_after_chase scene node (via CutControl 527). It is the only visible writer. The fact is never nonzero in any of the 110 saves, so it is untested. In the same scene the option 'Screw this, I'm out.' is the only option that writes the telemetry fact sq023_telem_joshua_killed, which suggests that leaving Joshua also counts as 'Joshua killed' in the game's own bookkeeping; who kills him (V or someone else) is not established, so the statement does not say V did it.
rows.unverifiedBecause: sq023_joshua_killed is zero in all real saves, and the scene exit that leads into the writer (combat_cleanup_out) was read from the graph but not confirmed in play. The telemetry flag on the 'I'm out' option raises doubt about whether V or another party kills Joshua.

rows.statement: At El Coyote Cojo V stepped in when two gangers tried to rob Pepe Najarro and talked them into walking away from him.
rows.notes: Scene mq040_01_bar (hash-bound export, heywood batch). The only writer of mq040_gangers_scene_done is node 919 (graph[155], =1 exact). The ganger confrontation is choice node 18 with five options: opt0 'Go ahead. Make my day.' (Confront) and opt1 (Bad Blood) lead into the fight lines (n20, n28); opt2 'Don't even start with me.' (Solo) and opt3 'Mama Welles doesn't like fights.' (Street Kid) lead to the ganger's backing-off line ('Not worth it'), after which node 919 fires; opt4 'Fine. Do what you want.' (Back off) goes elsewhere. The upstream walk shows node 919 reachable only from options 2 and 3 of choice 18 (the single-option intro choice 462 'Lay off him.' sits upstream of all of them). Only one writer exists (W1), no history-init or standalone phase writes it. Saves: 64a0c3 has mq040_gangers_scene_done=1 with the quest succeeded and journal 02_fight (pack key hw5.pepe.bar-fight) absent; the other three play-throughs that completed the quest (683244, 65a9d8, 5fd173) have 02_fight succeeded and the fact absent. The statement says only that V talked the two gangers down, which covers both talk-down options. It does not say anything about the later marriage advice.

rows.statement: When Lizzy Wizzy asked V to help get rid of Liam Northom's body, V refused to take part.
rows.notes: DRAFT ONLY, THIS CONDITION IS NOT EXCLUSIVE: mq019_done=1 (written by the finale phase after both routes) is also true after V agreed and moved the body. The real discriminator is a phone message that exists only on the refusal route. Phase mq019_06_finale (authenticated-oct01 export): scene node 7 'out_completed' goes to the move-body phase (node 23: 04_move_body, which sets mq019_liam_disposed on success or mq019_liam_disposed_failed=1 on a failed move) while the scene's 'out_failed' goes straight to the quest Succeeded node 47 -> 26 -> condition node 45 'mq019_liam_disposed_failed > 0'. When that fact is 0 (V never started the disposal) the False branch fires journal node 28, phone message contacts/lizzy_wizzy/mq019_05_no_job/01_lizzy_msg_no_reward; the True branch (a started-then-failed disposal) does not send it. So that message is active only when V refused in the scene. In all 9 playthroughs the message and its conversation are absent: the four saves that reached the finale (683244, 65a9d8, 65224c, 653802) all moved the body (04_move_body succeeded) and 64a0c3 never reached the finale. No real save of the refusal route exists, and the message is not in the pack journalAllowlist.
rows.unverifiedBecause: The only exclusive signal is journal contacts/lizzy_wizzy/mq019_05_no_job/01_lizzy_msg_no_reward, which is not in the pack allowlist and never appears in any of the 110 saves; the fact draft in condition also fires after the disposal route.

newJournal.role: sent only on the refusal route (condition 45 False branch: scene out_failed with mq019_liam_disposed_failed = 0); absent from every real save

rows.statement: Partway through the park stakeout Blue Moon gave up waiting, said she was going home, and the operation V was helping with ended there.
rows.notes: Scene mq028_02_park (hash-bound export, city-contacts batch). mq028_aborted has exactly three writers, all =1 and all directly after Blue Moon quits on screen: node 1267 (graph[161]) after her line that it is a waste of time and she is calling it a day (reached after the 03_defeat journal entry), node 1272 (graph[162], exact) after her line that this is pointless and she is going home (right after 02_watch), and node 1278 (graph[163]) after her line that V is not taking this seriously and she is going home. None of the three sits behind a player choice, so the fact marks the abort itself, not which V action caused it (waiting too long, leaving the area, or provoking the scene). Not written by any history-init phase. The fact has two readers, both inside the same scene. The root quest mq028 Failed state is shared with Blue Moon being killed or knocked out (prior review), so the quest state is not used.
rows.unverifiedBecause: mq028_aborted is never nonzero in any of the 110 saves (all three playthroughs that ran the quest completed it), is not in the pack factAllowlist, and the three writers have no player choice, so the cause on V's side (left versus compromised) is not established.
